name: hostpanel
description: Self-hosted cPanel-style control panel: multi-domain, multi-runtime (PHP, Node.js, Python, static) hosting with GitHub deploys

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/agent && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/agent && npm test -w apps/api
